_purpose: Validate the MIQ Polaris Email V3 package/date effect while requiring exact source detail, precedence, manual override, planned-carrier, supplier, and unrelated-package behavior.

custom_checks.name: polaris_detail_row_count
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'polaris_email'

custom_checks.name: polaris_spend_matches_landing
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS((SELECT SUM(_spend) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'polaris_email') - (SELECT SUM(spend) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.polaris_email_delivery_daily`)) AS value

custom_checks.name: polaris_impressions_match_landing
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS((SELECT SUM(_impressions) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'polaris_email') - (SELECT SUM(impressions) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.polaris_email_delivery_daily`)) AS value

custom_checks.name: polaris_clicks_match_landing
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS((SELECT SUM(_clicks) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'polaris_email') - (SELECT SUM(clicks) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.polaris_email_delivery_daily`)) AS value

custom_checks.name: polaris_video_views_match_landing
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS((SELECT SUM(_video_views) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'polaris_email') - (SELECT SUM(video_views) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.polaris_email_delivery_daily`)) AS value

custom_checks.name: polaris_video_completions_match_landing
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS((SELECT SUM(_video_comps) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'polaris_email') - (SELECT SUM(video_completions) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.polaris_email_delivery_daily`)) AS value

custom_checks.name: no_fpd_detail_inside_polaris_coverage
custom_checks.sql: WITH coverage AS (SELECT package_id, MIN(date) min_date, MAX(date) max_date FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.polaris_email_delivery_daily` GROUP BY package_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` v JOIN coverage c ON v._package_id = c.package_id AND v._date BETWEEN c.min_date AND c.max_date WHERE v.qa_v3_source_detail_type IN ('fpd_original', 'fpd_updated_package')

custom_checks.name: fpd_detail_remains_outside_polaris_coverage
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type IN ('fpd_original', 'fpd_updated_package')

custom_checks.name: miq_supplier_is_preserved
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(_supplier_name != 'MIQ DIGITAL USA INC' OR _supplier_name IS NULL) AS value FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` WHERE qa_v3_source_detail_type = 'polaris_email'

custom_checks.name: manual_overrides_suppress_other_source_metrics
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNTIF((v._spend IS NOT NULL OR v._impressions IS NOT NULL OR v._clicks IS NOT NULL OR v._video_views IS NOT NULL OR v._video_comps IS NOT NULL) AND v.qa_v3_source_detail_type != 'manual_package_daily') AS value FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` v JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT package_id, date FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.landing.master_data_model_manual_package_daily` WHERE man_daily_spend IS NOT NULL OR man_daily_impressions IS NOT NULL OR man_daily_clicks IS NOT NULL OR man_daily_video_plays IS NOT NULL OR man_daily_video_comps IS NOT NULL) m ON v._package_id = m.package_id AND v._date = m.date

custom_checks.name: one_planned_carrier_per_package_date
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT _package_id, _date FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__data_model_v3` GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNTIF(_planned_spend IS NOT NULL OR _planned_impressions IS NOT NULL) > 1)

custom_checks.name: unrelated_package_dates_have_no_meaningful_metric_change
custom_checks.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT * FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__v3_package_daily_baseline` WHERE package_id NOT IN ('P3HF7QB','P3HF7T8','P3HF88Q')), c AS (SELECT * FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.repo_stg.qa__polaris_email__v3_package_daily_candidate` WHERE package_id NOT IN ('P3HF7QB','P3HF7T8','P3HF88Q')) SELECT COUNTIF(ABS(COALESCE(b.spend,0)-COALESCE(c.spend,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.impressions,0)-COALESCE(c.impressions,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.clicks,0)-COALESCE(c.clicks,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.video_views,0)-COALESCE(c.video_views,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.video_completions,0)-COALESCE(c.video_completions,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.planned_spend,0)-COALESCE(c.planned_spend,0)) >= 0.000001 OR ABS(COALESCE(b.planned_impressions,0)-COALESCE(c.planned_impressions,0)) >= 0.000001 OR (b.package_id IS NULL) != (c.package_id IS NULL)) AS value FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c USING(package_id,date)
